restricted_keys.section_body: form_section and approval_panel section bodies — MUST be rendered by trusted module handler, never from user input or view model
restricted_keys.dialog_body: dialog body content — MUST be rendered by trusted module handler
restricted_keys.dialog_footer: dialog footer actions — MUST be rendered by trusted module handler
restricted_keys.status_badge: detail_header status badge — MUST be a pre-compiled workbench:status_badge include

raw_output.note: page_body and pagination are the only freely-allowed raw keys. Restricted keys carry mandatory usage constraints. All raw output must originate from compiled DiSyL templates or trusted module handlers — never from view models or user input.
raw_output.todo_01: Replace section_body/dialog_body/dialog_footer with structured contracts in Workbench 0.2

policy.csp_note: Workbench uses its own JS modules (workbench-core.js, workbench-dialog.js, etc.) rather than inline onclick handlers.
